properties.description: Apple Inc. is a leading global technology company that designs, develops, and sells consumer electronics, personal computing devices, and related digital services. The brand is widely recognized for its integrated ecosystem of hardware and software, including the iPhone, Mac, and iPad, which are supported by services like the App Store and iCloud. It maintains a premium market position by prioritizing intuitive user interfaces, privacy, and minimalist design. Through its retail presence and innovation-driven culture, the entity continues to influence global standards in mobile technology and digital interaction.
properties.short_description: Apple Inc is a global technology company known for its innovative products like iPhone, iPad, Mac, and services including software updates and device trade-in programs.

short_descriptions.value: Ein bahnbrechendes Technologieunternehmen, das für die nahtlose Integration von Hardware, Software und Services in ein einheitliches und intuitives Nutzererlebnis bekannt ist.

properties.description: An internet-based music streaming service that provides users with access to an expansive global library of songs, albums, and live radio programming. Launched as a core component of a larger technology ecosystem, it emphasizes human curation and high-quality audio experiences. The platform serves a broad, tech-savvy audience, integrating seamlessly across multiple hardware devices to provide a personalized listening environment. It maintains a strong market position by combining vast content availability with a user-centric design approach.
properties.short_description: Apple Music is a music streaming service offering millions of songs, curated playlists, and original content, available ad-free online and offline.

short_descriptions.value: Un service de streaming musical complet proposant des bibliothèques étendues, des playlists organisées et une intégration fluide avec un écosystème d'appareils mondial.
Un servicio de streaming musical integral que ofrece bibliotecas extensas, listas de reproducción curadas y una integración perfecta con todo un ecosistema de dispositivos.

properties.description: A premium subscription streaming service dedicated to high-quality, exclusive original content produced by leading industry filmmakers and creators. Founded by the technology company of the same name, it differentiates itself by eschewing a massive catalog of licensed content in favor of a curated selection of prestige series and films. It is deeply integrated into the digital ecosystem of its parent company, providing a seamless viewing experience across a wide range of devices. The service is aimed at viewers who prioritize production quality, narrative depth, and high-caliber acting over breadth of content.
properties.short_description: Apple TV+ is a streaming service from Apple featuring exclusive original shows and movies from top industry talent.

short_descriptions.value: Un service de streaming premium proposant des séries et des films originaux de haute qualité, produits par les meilleurs talents de l'industrie.
Ein Premium-Streaming-Dienst, der exklusive, hochwertige Originalserien und Filme von führenden Branchengrößen bietet.
A premium streaming service delivering exclusive, high-quality original television shows and films produced by top industry talent.

properties.description: Applebee's is a prominent American restaurant chain specializing in casual, neighborhood-style dining that caters to families and friends. Founded in 1980, it has grown into a massive network of locations known for its extensive menu of comfort food and bar favorites like burgers, ribs, and signature cocktails. The brand occupies a mainstream market position, prioritizing accessibility, affordability, and a relaxed, community-centered atmosphere. As a subsidiary of Dine Brands Global, it remains a cornerstone of the casual dining sector, focusing on a consistent, unpretentious experience that bridges the gap between fast food and fine dining.
properties.short_description: Applebee's is a popular casual dining restaurant chain known for its neighborhood grill and bar offering a variety of American dishes including steaks, pastas, and appetizers.

short_descriptions.value: Une chaîne de restaurants décontractée classique proposant un large choix de plats réconfortants américains et de cocktails signatures dans une atmosphère de quartier.
Eine klassische, zwanglose Restaurantkette, die ein umfangreiches Angebot an amerikanischem Comfort Food und Signature-Cocktails in einer nachbarschaftlichen Atmosphäre bietet.
A classic casual dining restaurant chain offering an extensive menu of American comfort foods and signature cocktails in a neighborhood-focused setting.
Una cadena clásica de restaurantes de ambiente informal que ofrece una amplia variedad de platos reconfortantes estadounidenses y cócteles insignia en un entorno familiar y cercano.

properties.description: A comprehensive digital news aggregation platform that provides users with curated stories and magazine content from hundreds of global publishers. Designed with a focus on editorial quality and user privacy, it offers a personalized reading experience that integrates seamlessly into the broader technology ecosystem. By bridging the gap between traditional journalism and mobile-first convenience, it serves as a central destination for daily information and long-form features. The service is widely recognized for its clean interface and the depth of its partnerships with major media organizations.
properties.short_description: Apple News is a news aggregation app by Apple offering top stories from over 400 leading publications, personalized news, and in-depth coverage.

short_descriptions.value: A curated news aggregation service providing personalized top stories and premium magazine content from hundreds of leading global publications.
